mapper.sql: select marking_id , slide_id , annotation_id , area , perimeter , measure_full_name , measure_type , measure_relation , measure_name , measure_number , radius , mean_distance , max_distance , min_distance , inner_angle , exterior_angle , center_point , annotation_type , location_type , create_by , create_time , point_count from tb_marking

SELECT t.annotation_type, t.marking_id, t.area, t.perimeter, t.description, t.category_id, t.measure_type, t.measure_relation, t.measure_name, t.measure_number, t.radius, t.mean_distance, t.max_distance, t.min_distance, t.inner_angle, t.exterior_angle, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.location_type, t.slide_id, t.center_point, t.point_count, t.annotation_owner, c.rgb as label_color, c.category_name as label_name,
c.category_name as measure_full_name, t.annotation_owner, t.annotation_update_owner, t.update_time, t.update_by, t.image_id, t.project_id -- t.image_url FROM tb_marking AS t LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS c ON t.category_id = c.category_id

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT_WS("_", t.measure_name, t1.category_name) as measure_full_name, t.point_count FROM tb_marking AS t LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS t1 ON t.category_id = t1.category_id

SELECT annotation_id, geometry, JSON_OBJECT( "annotation_type", t.annotation_type, "area", t.area, "perimeter", t.perimeter, "measure_type", t.measure_type, "measure_relation", t.measure_relation, "measure_name", t.measure_name, "measure_number", t.measure_number, "radius", t.radius, "mean_distance", t.mean_distance, "max_distance", t.max_distance, "min_distance", t.min_distance, "inner_angle", t.inner_angle, "exterior_angle", t.exterior_angle, "create_time", DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), "center_point", t.center_point, "annotation_owner", cast(t.create_by as char(200)), "label_color", c.rgb, "label_code", c.number, "number", t.number, "label_name", c.category_name, "measure_full_name",
c.category_name ) AS properties FROM tb_marking AS t LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS c ON t.category_id = c.category_id

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT_WS("_", t.measure_name, t1.category_name) as measure_full_name, t.point_count FROM tb_marking AS t LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS t1 ON t.category_id = t1.category_id

SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.marking_id, t.create_time, t.measure_name, t.category_id, 0 AS point_count, t.slide_id, t.perimeter, t.area, t.mean_distance, t.max_distance, t.min_distance, t.radius, t.inner_angle, t.exterior_angle,
c.category_name as measure_full_name, c.category_name FROM tb_marking AS t LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE t.measure_name != "P" AND t.slide_id = #{slideId} UNION ALL SELECT max ( t.marking_id ) AS marking_id, max ( t.create_time ) AS create_time, t.measure_name, t.category_id, sum ( 1 ) AS point_count, t.slide_id, max ( t.perimeter ) AS perimeter, max ( t.area ) AS area, max ( t.mean_distance ) AS mean_distance, max ( t.max_distance ) AS max_distance, max ( t.min_distance ) AS min_distance, max ( t.radius ) AS radius, max ( t.inner_angle ) AS inner_angle, max ( t.exterior_angle ) AS exterior_angle, CONCAT_WS( "_", t.measure_name, c.category_name ) AS measure_full_name, c.category_name FROM tb_marking AS t LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE measure_name = "P" AND slide_id = #{slideId} GROUP BY t.category_id) AS al
WHERE al.measure_full_name LIKE #{measureFullName}
ORDER BY al.create_time DESC

SELECT annotation_id, geometry, JSON_OBJECT( "annotation_type", t.annotation_type, "marking_id", t.marking_id, "area", t.area, "perimeter", t.perimeter, "description", t.description, "category_id", t.category_id, "measure_type", t.measure_type, "measure_relation", t.measure_relation, "measure_name", t.measure_name, "measure_number", t.measure_number, "radius", t.radius, "mean_distance", t.mean_distance, "max_distance", t.max_distance, "min_distance", t.min_distance, "inner_angle", t.inner_angle, "exterior_angle", t.exterior_angle, "create_by", t.create_by, "create_time", DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), "location_type", t.location_type, "slide_id", t.slide_id, "center_point", t.center_point, "point_count", t.point_count, "annotation_owner", t.annotation_owner, "label_color", c.rgb, "label_code", c.number, "number", t.number, "label_name", c.category_name, "measure_full_name",
c.category_name, "image_id", t.image_id, "update_by", t.update_by, "annotation_update_owner", t.annotation_update_owner, "project_id", t.project_id -- , -- "image_url", -- t.image_url ) AS properties, c.structure_id, c2.`organization_id`, c2.`name`, c2.type as structure_type FROM tb_marking AS t LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS c ON t.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN tb_structure AS c2 ON c.structure_id = c2.structure_id
mapper.select: SELECT p1.* FROM ( SELECT t1.category_id, t1.structure_id FROM tb_pathological_indicator_category t1 WHERE t1.indicator_id = #{indicatorId} AND t1.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND t1.del_flag = 0 )p1 LEFT JOIN tb_structure t2 ON p1.structure_id = t2.structure_id where t2.organization_id = #{organizationId} and t2.type in ('ROA','ROE')
where marking_id = #{markingId}
select * from tb_marking where marking_id = #{markingId}

SELECT t.topic_name, p.project_id, p.project_name, pi.species_id, pi.organ_id, i.file_name as image_name, i.format, i.image_url, p.indicator_id, s.create_time, CONCAT_WS(',', i.width, i.height) AS image_shape FROM tb_slide AS s LEFT JOIN tb_project AS p ON p.project_id = s.project_id LEFT JOIN tb_review_round AS re on re.review_round_id = s.review_round_id LEFT JOIN tb_topic AS t ON t.topic_id = re.topic_id LEFT JOIN tb_image AS i ON i.image_id = s.image_id LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator as pi on pi.indicator_id = p.indicator_id WHERE s.slide_id = #{slideId}

SELECT p.category_id, p.structure_id, p.category_code FROM tb_marking AS m LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS p ON p.category_id = m.category_id left join tb_structure as s on s.structure_id = p.structure_id WHERE m.slide_id = #{slideId} AND s.type = "RO" GROUP BY p.category_id;

SELECT t.topic_name, p.project_id, p.project_name, pi.species_id, pi.organ_id, i.file_name as image_name, i.format, i.image_url, p.indicator_id, s.create_time, CONCAT_WS(',', i.width, i.height) AS image_shape FROM tb_slide AS s LEFT JOIN tb_project AS p ON p.project_id = s.project_id LEFT JOIN tb_topic AS t ON t.topic_id = s.topic_id LEFT JOIN tb_image AS i ON i.image_id = s.image_id LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator as pi on pi.indicator_id = p.indicator_id WHERE s.slide_id = #{slideId}
where slide_id = #{slideId}

SELECT count(*) * 1 FROM tb_marking AS t LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS c ON t.category_id = c.category_id where slide_id = #{slideId} AND location_type != "Point"
and CONCAT_WS("_", CONCAT(t.measure_name, t.number), c.category_name) LIKE concat('%', #{measureFullName}, '%')
SELECT category_id, count(marking_id) AS point_count FROM tb_marking WHERE slide_id = #{slideId} AND location_type = "Point" GROUP BY category_id
